# Callouts: Recovery 1.4 - which J29 hole is the chip's TX (ohms)

Source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~229 px/mm)  
Annotated image: [images/annotated/rec1-4_j29-to-u1.jpg](../../../images/annotated/rec1-4_j29-to-u1.jpg)

Ohms from J29 hole 1 and hole 2 to U1 pins 55 and 57 (count along the top edge from pin 49, the rightmost toe). A series resistor sits in each path, so a few hundred ohms is a hit. The hole on pin 55 is the chip's TX.
